comment: The campus places the app names (docs/app-plan/04-api.md, 'Regions and feeding spots'). PLACEHOLDERS: the names come from the prototype, the coordinates are approximate and made up, and the feeding spots are made up too (the campus has set ones; these stand in until the owner's list). The owner supplies the real ones (docs/app-plan/OWNER_STEPS.md, O12). Read by the map, the new-cat form and the API (src/common/regions.py); an id, once used, never changes meaning.
